channels.name: Specialist insider shorthand assuming a small expert readership
channels.upstream_parent: The comment sits in a small specialist docket with few filers, where the writer expects a handful of agency technical staff — not a general public — to read it.

channels.name: Identified accountable author with stated standing
channels.upstream_parent: professional or organisational correspondence practice

channels.name: Addressee-directed numbered items with rule-citation tags
channels.upstream_parent: the submitter is a regulated entity's engineering/compliance staff responding to a routine Airworthiness Directive or product-specific technical requirement as an established business process, not an independent stakeholder building a persuasive case

channels.name: Letter furniture: salutation and signature block
channels.upstream_parent: professional or organisational correspondence practice

channels.name: Explicit disclosure of past dealings with agency
channels.upstream_parent: existing relationships with agency personnel or programs

channels.name: Density of figures, citations and named sources
channels.upstream_parent: professional advocacy research and briefing support

channels.name: De novo issue scaffolding versus incorporation by reference
channels.upstream_parent: Early ordinal position in the filing sequence: little or nothing was in the record at drafting time, so there was nothing available to endorse, join, or incorporate.

channels.name: Deadline, extension, and re-opened-period timing language
channels.upstream_parent: Where the comment's filing timestamp falls relative to the opening and closing of the comment period, including whether it landed in an extended, re-opened, or post-deadline window.

channels.name: Mentions of prior contact with the agency
channels.upstream_parent: Existing relationships and insider access within the agency or docket lifecycle

channels.name: Mass-campaign petition register
channels.upstream_parent: The comment sits in a large, high-salience, mass-participation docket where an advocacy campaign drove filings, so docket size is enormous relative to a specialist rulemaking.

channels.name: Adversarial legal register and violation language
channels.upstream_parent: Professional litigation or regulatory-counsel involvement

channels.name: Awareness of the accumulated docket record
channels.upstream_parent: Late ordinal position in the sequence of filings, and long elapsed time since the docket opened, so that a public record and post-proposal developments were available to read and cite.

channels.name: Attachment or exhibit is referenced
channels.upstream_parent: resources to prepare supporting documents
